_note: This file is the editable source. scripts/build.js turns it into
shared/weapons.js, which is what the browser imports - so there is one file
to edit and nothing is fetched at runtime.
Colours are named tokens, not hex: `set` refers to a set in spaces.js, so
the three weapon colours are the board's own and cannot drift from it.
The three chosen are indigo, terracotta and teal - the three calmest on the
board, and each far enough from the other two to be told apart at pill size.
KRONOS - the shield chest, in the same file because it is the same kind of
thing: one draw, decided from data, shown by the same card. A shield names
ONE weapon in `counters` - the weapon's own id, never a name retyped - and
blocks that weapon and no other. Its colour is its own set (violet, green,
gold) so a shield never reads as the weapon it stops, while its EMBLEM is
that weapon's emblem, so the face still says which weapon it answers.

chest._label: The card used to carry a 'COMMUNITY CHEST' label where a property puts its price. It is gone: the title already says what this is, and the label was taking the width the title needed. The word is kept here only so it is not lost if the card wants to say it somewhere else.
chest.title: Welcome to Ragnarok
chest.tagline: The armoury at the end of time.
chest.body: Ragnarok is where weapons are drawn. Draw once per visit and you may leave with one. Carry your weapons to Fight, where you can strike an opponent's colony. Every weapon can only reach certain colonies, and a successful strike hands that colony to you.
chest._titleLines: The title is too long for one line in the card's title column at a phone's cell size, and an ellipsis reading 'WELCO...' is worse than a break. The break lives here rather than being guessed in the card, for the same reason every board name carries its own lines: the drawing and the data cannot then disagree about where something wraps.

weapons.name: Nuclear Warhead
weapons.blurb: Hits solid worlds and objects within reach.

kronos.title: Welcome to Kronos
kronos._titleLines: One line, unlike Ragnarok's two: the shield-circle's welcome is short enough to stand on a single line at every phone cell size, and the card keeps its own typography to say it - no smaller type, no tightened tracking, just no break where none is needed.
kronos.tagline: The shield-circle at the end of time.
kronos.body: Kronos offers a shield. Draw once per visit: it deploys the moment it is drawn, stands for two of your own turns, and is spent the instant it stops its one weapon. It answers no other - the remaining weapons pass it by.

shields.name: Kavacha of Parvati
shields.blurb: A veil no gaze may pierce.
shields.myth: The armour Parvati wove for her son - no gaze may pierce it.
shields.stands: Stops the Eye of Shiva, once.

shields.name: Matterforge Shield
shields.blurb: Matter re-woven faster than it can be undone.
shields.myth: Struck where matter is unmade, it re-weaves faster than it can be undone.

shields.name: Nuclear Aegis
shields.blurb: A hush of hardened light around what it keeps.
shields.myth: Star-forged in a dying sun's collapse, a hush of hardened light.
